value.reason: The evidence stores an authentication token in localStorage. localStorage is readable by any JavaScript running on the page, so an XSS flaw anywhere in the origin could exfiltrate the token. Persistent storage also outlives the session. This matches the SEC-10 rule's concern about token storage. The snippet alone doesn't show the surrounding context, such as whether the app is free of XSS, but the pattern itself is the flagged risk.
